title: Daughter: Dad fell, we're at the hospital, come when you can
sources: Hard negative: a real family emergency with no money, payment, or secrecy request

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mom, it's Maya. Dad slipped on the porch steps, we're at St. Mary's. He's okay, they think it's just a sprained wrist.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh no. Should I come now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Come when you're ready, no rush. Bring his reading glasses, he keeps asking for them.
